name: overnight-unstarted-note
about: An overnight run still not started at 07:00 gets a note in #loop saying why, once (#317). The approver schedules tonight's run; a runner that serves only regressions keeps polling, and #a waits in triage all night, so the queue is never quiet. At 07:00 #loop says the run has not started and why (what the queue is busy with); the store and Slack tests check it is posted once.

messages.text: ^\*Overnight regression R1 has not started\* \(set for 01:00 on Fri Oct 16\): the queue is busy: .+\.$
